scheme_name: Marriage Grant for the Marriage of Daughters of Widows of Ex-servicemen (other than War Widows)
other_conditions: Applicant must be the widow of an ex‑serviceman who did not die in war (non‑war widow)
Applicant must not have remarried, except if the remarriage is to the real brother of her late husband
Benefit is available for up to two daughters of the widow
Each daughter must be at least 18 years old
Verification of claimants is carried out by the Secretaries of Zila Sainik Boards
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹11,000 per daughter for the marriage of up to two daughters of widows of ex‑servicemen (non‑war widows).
